_about: The upgrade machine (needs power). With a gun in hand: `reroll` points = the same tier with everything rolled anew (parts, numbers, buffs, skills); `tier_up` x the number of the new tier (green 1, blue 2 ...) = one tier higher and rolled anew, up to `top_tier`; a plain gun becomes the first tier for `plain_to_first`. Hand-made guns are refused.
